description: Read one offering's stored availability without sign-in; this does not refresh the provider. Returns id, title, priceCents, price_type, price, price_display, source_type, data_age_seconds, data_coverage, availability and withheld. Availability is null unless connector data within its freshness window, a non-listed plan, BILLING_ENTITLEMENTS_ENABLED=true and STRIPE_MODE=test/live allow it; withheld results include contact next steps. A missing offering returns offering_not_found.
name: check_availability
title: Check availability
